# Security & Sign-in Flow Requirements Checklist: Operator Sign-in

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements: are authentication, second factor, recovery, sessions, lockout, audit, guard coverage, localisation and browser-testability written completely, clearly and consistently?
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Review run 2026-10-04 by the design agent under the owner's delegated authority (owner away; the parent asked for gaps to be fixed). Items marked `[x]` were satisfied as written or after the fix noted inline. Depth: release gate. Audience: PR reviewer and Playwright QA.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are authentication requirements specified for every back-office surface, including the shared component update endpoint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-070–FR-073]
- [x] CHK002 Are the exceptions to the guard enumerated exhaustively (sign-in steps, set-up steps, local gallery)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-070, contracts/routes-and-screens.md]
- [x] CHK003 Are provisioning, password recovery and offboarding of operators all specified, given there is no operators screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-005, FR-063]
- [x] CHK004 Is a lifetime defined for the temporary password? [Gap → fixed: FR-004a, 72 hours]
- [x] CHK005 Are lifetimes defined for every half-finished state (second factor, new password, enrolment, recovery-codes confirmation)? [Gap → fixed: FR-014, data-model `auth.pending_minutes`]
- [x] CHK006 Are the protected-at-rest requirements stated for every new stored attribute (email, display name, password, secret, pending secret, recovery codes, failure counter)? [Completeness, Clarifications Q6, data-model, research R-10]
- [x] CHK007 Is the display-name length constrained? [Gap → fixed: FR-002, 1–80 characters]
- [x] CHK008 Are audit requirements listed per act, with the act that produces no entry (idle/absolute expiry) stated explicitly? [Gap → fixed: FR-083; contracts/commands-and-audit.md]
- [x] CHK009 Are accessibility requirements defined for the six-box code entry (paste, keyboard, labels, error announcement, no-JS fallback)? [Gap → fixed: FR-092]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Are code parameters (digits, step, drift) quantified rather than described? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Is "used once" for codes defined precisely (same or earlier step refused), not just "no reuse"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK012 Is "recent" re-confirmation quantified (10 minutes) and are the qualifying proofs named (code, recovery code, the sign-in itself)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-060, US5-6]
- [x] CHK013 Are idle and absolute session limits quantified and is "request" defined to include component updates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040, US6-2]
- [x] CHK014 Are lockout thresholds, durations and the cap quantified and tied to the baseline? [Clarity, Spec §FR-050–FR-052]
- [x] CHK015 Is the recovery-code input tolerance (case, hyphen) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023; contracts/second-factor.md]
- [x] CHK016 Is every user-facing message for refusals given as exact copy, so tests can assert it? [Clarity, US1–US7, contracts/routes-and-screens.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK017 Does the re-enrolment approver count agree between the baseline ("two other operators"), the spec and the design board ("a second operator")? [Conflict → resolved: Clarifications Q8, baseline wins; copy changed]
- [x] CHK018 Do the reset-password command and the second-factor rule agree (a reset never skips the code of an enrolled operator)? [Consistency → fixed: FR-063, data-model states]
- [x] CHK019 Are the audit vocabulary choices consistent with the baseline's "fixed vocabulary" and "one writer per event" rules, with the amendments named? [Consistency, Clarifications Q4, research R-13]
- [x] CHK020 Is the recovery-codes "shown once" rule consistent across US2-7/8, the edge cases and the screen contract (no reload re-display)? [Consistency → fixed: edge case rewritten; R-11]
- [x] CHK021 Are session-ending triggers consistent between US6-4, FR-042 and the data model's credential epoch? [Consistency, data-model `credential_epoch`]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 Is every success criterion measurable without knowing the implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-008]
- [x] CHK023 Does every invariant name the test that fails when it is broken? [Traceability, Spec §4]
- [x] CHK024 Are acceptance scenarios phrased as browser-drivable steps (page, input, visible outcome) for Playwright, with stable hooks named? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios, contracts/routes-and-screens.md "Playwright selectors"]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are primary, alternate (recovery code), exception (wrong code, lock, timeout) and recovery (re-enrolment) flows all specified? [Coverage, US1, US3, US4, US7]
- [x] CHK026 Are concurrent scenarios addressed (same code on two browsers, two simultaneous approvals)? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Is the behaviour of a lock on an already signed-in session specified? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases "Lock while signed in"]
- [x] CHK028 Is the case of too few operators to approve a re-enrolment specified? [Coverage, US4-10]
- [x] CHK029 Is the expectation that approvers verify the requester out of band stated? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases "Who approves"]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK030 Are clock drift, deactivation mid-sign-in, last-operator deactivation, back button after sign-out and JS-disabled browsers addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Is the post-sign-in redirect restricted to back-office pages (no open redirect)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK032 Are caching and framing restrictions specified for every back-office response? [Security, Spec §FR-043; research R-16]
- [x] CHK033 Is timing equalisation required for unknown email vs wrong password? [Security, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK034 Is session-identifier rotation required at each privilege change? [Security, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK035 Are English/Arabic, direction and Western-digit requirements stated for every screen? [Localisation, Spec §FR-091, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK036 Are logging-redaction requirements specified for the new secret-bearing fields? [Security, plan P-15 row]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK037 Is the "no new dependency" constraint reflected in the enrolment requirement (no QR picture required)? [Dependency, Clarifications Q10, R-4]
- [x] CHK038 Is the assumption that artisan access equals full deployment control stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK039 Is the minimum of three operators for re-enrolment stated as an assumption with a risk? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, US4-10]
